meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas (live data, not an archived version; give corpus_snapshot and source_commit). doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: Active mTORC1 phosphorylates ULK1 at an inhibitory site, holding autophagy shut while nutrients are plentiful.
data.mechanism_beginner: Active mTORC1 tags ULK1 to hold it back, keeping the cell's self-cleanup process (autophagy) switched off while nutrients are plentiful.
data.boundary: Mammalian and human/mouse cell studies (HOS2009, GAN2009, KIM2011, NAZ2013, ZHO2026). Cell-culture biochemistry; the whole-animal and human consequence is not shown by these sources. ZHO2026 adds the spatial qualifier: inhibiting mTORC1 specifically at the lysosome lowers ULK1 phosphorylation, while inhibiting the nuclear pool does not.

confidence.human_relevance_label: plausible in people, not shown directly
